explanation.whatYouSee: The page develops a hierarchy by repeatedly comparing clusters or by defining a rule for when the hierarchy should stop.
explanation.whyItMatters: Hierarchical clustering exposes the choice of geometry and stopping criterion instead of hiding both inside one final partition.
explanation.intuition: A merge is a commitment: the chosen notion of closeness says which shape of cluster the method is prepared to preserve.
explanation.technicalDetail: Read the linkage, representative, or cohesion definition on lecture page 14; it determines the next merge or cut of the dendrogram.
explanation.pitfall: Do not treat every linkage rule as equivalent: single-link can bridge chains, while complete-link penalises far-apart members.
explanation.connection: This is the hand-worked clustering decision that Assignment 1 asks you to calculate on pages 6–8.
